comments.author: Slothgang
comments.body_html: This is great for a zero to hero run although don’t you need Epsilon for Kappa?

comments.author: Slothgang
comments.body_html: Though it’s still a great mod, I have just changed the requirements to include a Microcontroller board and a phased array element instead of the Epsilon. Thanks!

comments.author: Dezzy_fb
comments.body_html:
The epsilon container is required for “The Choice”, lvl 50 quest from the fence. It’s not required for Kappa, however (according to the wiki at least, unsure if this is true for our version of the game).

The quest rewards a ton of XP and money as well as gives you some hideout management levels and fence rep.

Another potential solution beyond editing the mod.ts file is to add an epsilon barter to Peacekeeper 4. I personally like the idea of trading up containers, but losing epsilon does lock you out of “The Choice.”
